name: nijin
about: nijin (二陣, the second wave), the second campaign of Ten-Go (1 Nov 2026): the skeleton of the second curve of Fig. 0NNbp, gamma_sigma = 23141/682840 g = 0.3389 gamma_a (gamma_a = 0.1 g), on 0.15-12.51 g; first a pilot that sets the orders, then the grid 0.15 + 0.004 j g in van der Corput order (added by --zoen once the pilot has spoken)

parts.about: the pilot: 16 pumps of the grid to come (0.15 + 0.004 j g) at orders 150 with weights, 200, 250, 300 and 400, all at 80 digits, and 300 at 160 digits at 5.502, 6.002 and 11.002 g: up to what pump 150/200 (B) agrees with 300/400 (E) at this gamma_sigma, whether 250/300 (D) does above, and whether 80 digits hold; the orders of the grid follow from it (code/nijin_pilot.py)
